- **Measured:** 2,073 changed source/test lines (numstat `79b13533..HEAD -- crates/`: closure.rs +1,313, tests/r5_22.rs +755, lib.rs +5) vs ≤1000 (~2.07×).
- **One owner interface:** Packet C C.1 items 3–4 + C.4 make `closure_walk`/`closure_report` a single in-process owner interface — the report is the walk's own fold (`closure.rs` returns `ClosureReport`; the only separable piece is the `closure-report/1` codec). Decomposition assigns "traversal" whole to R5.22; the documented boundaries are the R5.21 data-owner and R5.23+ consumer ticket seams.
- **Documented conditional seam exists but does not split legally:** this ticket's own partition row (execution-partition R2; L150 "environment reference enumerators after common closure") is the first in the sequence to document an intra-ticket contingency — "if per-owner enumerators are broad, split support-only producer batches after shared closure interface, retain F005 owner final composed traversal". Antecedent unmet: the per-owner enumerations are ~360 compact hh-bundle lines reading owner-typed declared fields via `classes::lookup` — the class table IS the "owner-supplied typed closure inputs" mechanism; no producer-crate batch exists and C.1 item 6 forbids a new crate edge. Non-curative: the contingency reserves the final composed traversal to the F005 owner, so the re-scoped leg still lands ~950 src + battery share — over trigger. No independently-true leg predicate — contrast X7/M-A/D.2, where each leg was self-true.
- **AC predicate spans every cut:** AC-1 is conjunctive (enumerate ALL root classes AND resolve member/fetch/redacted/gc truthfully); AC-2 negatives live on both sides. Interface-first leg reports `closed`/`withheld` over unenumerated classes — a false pass for the payload/IR/cause losses AC-2 forbids; enumeration-only leg is edge machinery nothing consumes.
- **Magnitude in band:** ~2.07× inside the accepted envelope (≤2.6× R5.8; ~1.85–2.4× routinely amended).
